instruction: Using a terminal command, convert all .doc files in the current directory to plain text (.txt) format.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting 12 .doc files to .txt format. Verified from cache: 12 .doc files exist. Agent should use command like 'soffice --headless --convert-to txt *.doc' or equivalent.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirements of the conversion task
Getter extracts comprehensive state: .txt count, .doc count, matched conversions (basenames matching both .doc and .txt), and content verification
Metric uses multi-criteria scoring: 40% for correct .txt count, 40% for filename matching, 20% for content verification
Filename matching check prevents false positives from pre-existing .txt files with wrong names
Content verification (checking files are non-empty) prevents passing with empty file creation
Logical data flow is correct: getter extracts the right state, metric compares appropriate aspects
Minor limitation: Content verification samples only 5 files instead of all 12, but this is a reasonable practical trade-off
Minor limitation: Only checks files are non-empty (test -s), not deep content quality, but sufficient for basic conversion verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Check all 12 files for content instead of sampling 5 files for more thorough verification
Optional enhancement: Could verify content length is reasonable (e.g., > 10 bytes) to catch trivial conversions
